callouts.title: Silverman-Toepliz定理,1913
callouts.body:
$a_{n,k}$是一个非负的双重序列，并且满足:
1. 关于$k$的和为1，即:$$\sum_{k=1}^na_{n,k}=1$$
2. 当$k$固定的时候，$$\lim_{n\to \infty}a_{n,k}=0$$

那么对于任意的有极限的序列$x_n$，都有$$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k=1}^{n}a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n$$

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $a_{n,k}$ be a nonnegative double sequence such that:
1. the sum over $k$ is $1$, namely $$\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}=1,$$
2. for each fixed $k$, $$\lim_{n\to\infty} a_{n,k}=0.$$
Then for every convergent sequence $x_n$, one has
$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to\infty}x_n.$$
key_techniques: splitting a convergent sequence into limit plus error

callouts.title: 命题2.1:Silverman-Toepliz定理的推广
callouts.body:
$a_{n,k}$是一个双重序列，并且满足:
1. 关于$k$的和**渐进**为1，即:$$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k=1}^na_{n,k}=1$$
2. 当$k$固定的时候，$$\lim_{n\to \infty}a_{n,k}=0$$
3. $$\sup_{n\in \mathbb{N}^{+}}\sum_{k\leq n}|a_{n,k}|<+\infty$$

那么对于任意的有极限的序列$x_n$，都有$$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k=1}^{n}a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n$$

classification_result.english_title: Proposition 2.1: Generalization of the Silverman-Toeplitz Theorem

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $a_{n,k}$ be a double sequence such that:
1. the sum over $k$ tends asymptotically to $1$, namely $$\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}=1,$$
2. for each fixed $k$, $$\lim_{n\to\infty} a_{n,k}=0,$$
3. $$\sup_{n\in\mathbb{N}^{+}}\sum_{k\le n}|a_{n,k}|<+\infty.$$
Then for every convergent sequence $x_n$, one has
$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to\infty}x_n.$$

callouts.title: 例子2.2
callouts.body: $|\lambda|<1$序列$x_n$的极限为$a$，那么$$\sum_{k=0}^{n}\lambda^{n-k}x_k\to \frac{a}{1-\lambda}$$这是因为$\sum_{k=0}^{n}\lambda^{n-k}=\frac{1-\lambda^{n+1}}{1-\lambda}$，所以Silverman-Toepliz定理的推广版本告诉我们$$\sum_{k=0}^{n}\lambda^{n-k}(1-\lambda)x_k\to a$$从而得到结果。

if_problem.statement_en:
If $|\lambda|<1$ and the sequence $x_n$ converges to $a$, then
$$\sum_{k=0}^{n}\lambda^{n-k}x_k\to \frac{a}{1-\lambda}.$$

callouts.title: 例子2.3:去掉条件3之后的反例
callouts.body: 令$$a_{n,k}:=\begin{cases}1&(n,k)=(1,1)\\n&(n,k)=(n,n)\\1-n&(n,k)=(n,n-1)\\0&\text{otherwise}\end{cases}$$这个序列可以看成一个无穷的矩阵$A$当中的元素：$$A:=\begin{pmatrix}1&0&0&\cdots\\-1&2&0&\cdots\\ 0&-2&3&\cdots \\\vdots&\vdots&\vdots&\ddots \\0&\cdots&1-n&n\\\vdots&\vdots&\vdots&\ddots \end{pmatrix}$$这样的双重序列并不满足“命题2.1”的第三个条件，因为此时$$\sum_{k\leq n}|a_{n,k}|=2\sum_{k=1}^{n} k=n(n+1)$$令$x_k:=\frac{(-1)^k}{k}$那么$$\sum_{k\leq n} a_{n,k}x_k = a_{n,n-1}x_{n-1}+a_{n,n}x_{n}=2(-1)^n$$这个和的极限不存在，更不会等于$x_k$的极限0。

if_problem.statement_en:
Define
$$a_{n,k}:=\begin{cases}1&(n,k)=(1,1)\\n&(n,k)=(n,n)\\1-n&(n,k)=(n,n-1)\\0&\text{otherwise.}\end{cases}$$
This double sequence does not satisfy condition 3 of Proposition 2.1. Let $$x_k:=\frac{(-1)^k}{k}.$$ Then
$$\sum_{k\le n} a_{n,k}x_k = a_{n,n-1}x_{n-1}+a_{n,n}x_n = 2(-1)^n,$$
so the limit of the sum does not exist, and therefore it cannot equal the limit $0$ of $x_k$.
key_techniques: direct evaluation of the transformed sequence
